```sql
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    SUM(gross_sales - discount_amount - COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) AS net_sales,
    SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
    SUM(orders) AS orders,
    SUM(stockout_hours) AS stockout_hours
  FROM memory.main.data
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
  'first_30d' AS period,
  COUNT(*) AS days,
  SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales,
  SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend,
  SUM(net_sales) / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS roas,
  SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
  SUM(orders) AS orders,
  SUM(stockout_hours) AS stockout_hours
FROM daily
WHERE date <= DATE '2025-01-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'last_29d',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(net_sales),
  SUM(ad_spend),
  SUM(net_sales) / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend), 0),
  SUM(sessions),
  SUM(orders),
  SUM(stockout_hours)
FROM daily
WHERE date > DATE '2025-01-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'all',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(net_sales),
  SUM(ad_spend),
  SUM(net_sales) / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend), 0),
  SUM(sessions),
  SUM(orders),
  SUM(stockout_hours)
FROM daily;
```

-- Purpose: Compare campaign-level performance between the first 30 days and last 29 days to identify net-sales decline drivers and ad-spend efficiency.
```sql
WITH periodized AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN date <= DATE '2025-01-30' THEN 'first_30d' ELSE 'last_29d' END AS period,
    campaign,
    gross_sales,
    discount_amount,
    COALESCE(refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount,
    ad_spend,
    sessions,
    orders,
    units,
    returned_units,
    stockout_hours
  FROM memory.main.data
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    campaign,
    SUM(gross_sales - discount_amount - COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) AS net_sales,
    SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
    SUM(orders) AS orders,
    SUM(units) AS units,
    SUM(returned_units) AS returned_units,
    SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) AS refund_amount,
    SUM(gross_sales) AS gross_sales,
    SUM(stockout_hours) AS stockout_hours
  FROM periodized
  GROUP BY period, campaign
)
SELECT
  period,
  campaign,
  net_sales,
  ad_spend,
  net_sales / NULLIF(ad_spend, 0) AS roas,
  sessions,
  orders,
  orders * 1.0 / NULLIF(sessions, 0) AS conv_rate,
  net_sales / NULLIF(orders, 0) AS net_sales_per_order,
  stockout_hours,
  returned_units * 1.0 / NULLIF(units, 0) AS return_rate,
  discount_amount / NULLIF(gross_sales, 0) AS discount_rate,
  refund_amount / NULLIF(gross_sales, 0) AS refund_rate
FROM agg
ORDER BY campaign, period;
```

Verification:
- 首30天 vs 后29天：净销售额 1063.2万 -> 1019.0万（-4.2%），投放 11.05万 -> 14.81万（+34.0%），ROAS 96.2 -> 68.8；sessions、orders 基本持平。
- 分活动：常规经营净销售额下降但投放也下降，ROAS 约 96 -> 100；新品组合推荐 ROAS 201.5，春节促销 ROAS 27.0（折扣率27%、退货率15.4%），限时折扣 ROAS 21.9（折扣率22%）。
- 分SKU：COF-01 净销售额 -8.1%，投放 +87.2%，ROAS 174.0 -> 85.5，库存中断168小时，退货率 2.6% -> 6.0%；KET-01 投放 +38.3% 但净销售额 -5.6%，ROAS 49.7 -> 33.9。

Conclusion:
不建议现在全面加大投放。应先压缩/暂停低ROAS的春节促销和限时折扣，把预算优先给新品组合推荐，常规经营保持并优化；同时先解决COF-01缺货和退货率上升问题，KET-01需降低投放或优化转化。库存和退货修复后，再按严格ROAS阈值小步测试增量，而不是直接扩量。
